items.title: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames
items.description: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames. Using only the best aluminum available and the original UFS Angle design by Pieter Wijnant, Symetrics created a WZRD frame optimized for flatland skating, also known as Wizard skating. The perfect Wizard Skating Setup. The WZRD F frame is unique in every way. These Wizard Skating Frames feature a Hi-Lo wheel setup that improves reaction time while skating and offers much-needed responsiveness, thanks to a 5-wheel frame. It also uses the space inside the frame optimally by placing smaller wheels in front and larger wheels in back. The Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames have a 1-3-1 rocker combination. When the base wheels (3 middle wheels) are flat on the ground, the 80-80-84 combination in the center lets the frame turn faster. In total, the wheels used are (front to back): 80mm – 80mm – 80mm – 84mm – 84mm, with the front and rear wheels rockered. This frame also features an angled UFS. Originally designed in 2014 by Pieter Wijnant, it creates a more playful UFS frame with a flat boot design. Pieter has studied and designed the Symetrics frames to create the right angle for orthopedic comfort and performance. The UFS mount on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames uses a longer slot, so it can be perfectly centered or more toe- or heel-based. By using closed-wall construction on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames, with Symetrics angled cutouts at the bottom and CNC-machined from a billet block of 7075 aluminum (the highest grade in the industry), Symetrics created a unique sound and feel. The strategic placement ensures that valuable items remain protected and accessible without compromising on comfort. The backpack’s versatility is further enhanced by a detachable front bag, featuring its own shoulder straps that can be clipped to the bag for independent use. Adding to its comprehensive features, the Chaya Pro Roller Skate Backpack includes a removable helmet net at the front of the bag. The bottom compartment is now firmly connected to the main compartment and features air ventilation, perfect for storing worn gear or shoes. An integrated zipped rain cover has been added to protect the backpack against the elements. Reflective pipings and prints on the backpack increases visibility, enhancing safety for night-time activities, a thoughtful addition for those who skate after dark. With its combination of comfort, security, and additional smart features, the Chaya Pro Roller Skate Backpack is truly a standout, designed to meet and exceed the demands of modern skaters who require functionality and style in every element of their gear.
